cues: Section 2 is a decision table with 'Default (chosen now)' and 'Revisit trigger' columns, and every gate has an explicit flip condition. This is a formulaic methodology feature.
Opens with a Classification section (type, dominant constraint, worst failure), then a 'first end-to-end slice (Phase 0)' with tiers crossed, deployed, logged, monitored, and an exit check.
Every phase uses the same template: Unlocks, Depends on, Tasks, Exit check. Phases are ordered by dependency ('widest impact first within each').
A per-phase cross-cutting matrix (Security, Observability, Reproducibility, Resilience) applies 'from the first commit'. The plan is clearly built to a checklist.

A dedicated AI layer section covers guardrails, cost/latency budget, HITL, retrieval, model access, memory, orchestration, routing and feedback, each with an exit test. It also has a 'Deferred' table with pull-forward conditions and a closing 'Questions that could change the plan' section tied to the gates.
